meta.source: Yahoo-Finance-style daily history supplied by the team (13 securities), 3 Oct 2016 - 30 Sep 2026, cleaned by the team validation step
meta.adjustment: Equities: Adj Close (dividend and split adjusted, total-return style). Indices: Close (price indices, no dividends).
meta.gaps: No forward-fill. Return is set to missing if either consecutive session is missing. Nifty Financial Services has 16 missing sessions.
meta.estimation: Market model, estimation window [-250,-31] sessions, minimum 120 valid returns, other events within +/-20 sessions excluded
